title: Sunset Serenity | Gulf Front Laguna Beach Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Luxury Gulf-front retreat with private beach access, pool with swim-up bar, spa, gym, multiple living spaces, and stunning sunset views in Laguna Beach.
description_expanded: Sunset Serenity Features - Private Pool with spa and swim up bar. Pool and spa can be heated for an additional fee for reservations October - April - Gulf Front home with private entrance to beach - Access to 6 Taxi Bikes, perfect for exploring the neighborhood - Outdoor shower at the private beach entrance - Cushioned chairs plus lounge seating poolside on the sundeck - Cabana Bath next to the pool. No need to head inside to use the powder room. - Multiple furnished Gulf facing porches and balconies with daybed swings and cushioned seating - 1st Floor Family room with sectional sofa, kitchenette with microwave, coffee maker, and beverage fridge, and large Smart TV - 4th Floor gym with free weights, elliptical machine, Body Kore All-In-One Training System, Hoist Leg Press machine, bench, TV, and Powder Room - 3rd Floor Deluxe Bunk Room and Lounge with kitchenette, TV, and sectional sofa - 2nd Floor Main living area with panoramic Gulf views - 2nd Floor gourmet kitchen with high end appliances, separate expansive bar with seating and color-changing LED lights, and large kitchen island with additional seating. It's party time every night! - Breakfast bar seating for 4, Bar seating for 4 and dining table seating for 8 - Outdoor gas grill, smoker, mini-fridge and wet bar seating next to the pool - Outdoor dining for 8 under the covered patio poolside - Incredible deluxe king suite with private office, Gulf views, spa bath, kitchenette and sitting area - Private elevator travels to floors 1 - 3. Adult use only. Please ask for details regarding mobility considerations for anyone in your group - Main Laundry room on 1st floor - Ping Pong table in the garage - Smart TVs, cable, and WIFI throughout the home - Driveway parking for 7 vehicles - Close to shopping and dining, including Publix and Back Beach Barbecue - Less than 10-minute drive to Rosemary Beach with upscale shopping and dining - 15 Minutes to Pier Park with even more shopping, dining, movie theater, and Ferris Wheel - Concierge services available, including baby equipment delivery, grocery delivery, private chef, boat charters, and more - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Welcome to your luxurious Gulf-front retreat, where every moment is a seamless blend of comfort, elegance, and coastal serenity. Nestled along the pristine shores of the Gulf, this exquisite home offers a plethora of amenities to ensure an unforgettable stay in picturesque Laguna Beach. Step into an oasis of relaxation as you enter the spacious interiors adorned with designer touches and contemporary furnishings. The expansive living areas beckon you to unwind with loved ones, boasting plush seating, abundant natural light, and captivating views of the azure waters beyond. Whether lounging with a book or enjoying lively conversations, every corner of this residence exudes warmth and sophistication. Entertainment knows no bounds in this coastal haven. Challenge friends and family to a friendly game of ping pong or retreat to one of the multiple living rooms for movie nights and cozy gatherings. With ample space for everyone to spread out and indulge in leisurely pursuits, boredom is simply not an option. Escape to your own private oasis outdoors, where the sounds of the sea mingle with laughter and relaxation. Take a refreshing dip in the shimmering pool or bask in the Florida sun on the expansive sundeck. As evening falls, gather around the poolside lounge area for alfresco dining or cocktails under the stars, creating cherished memories that will last a lifetime. Embrace the coastal lifestyle with complimentary bicycles provided for exploring the picturesque surroundings. Cruise along scenic paths, breathe in the salty sea air, and immerse yourself in the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. With breathtaking Gulf views as your backdrop, every moment spent in this captivating home is a celebration of luxury, comfort, and coastal charm. Experience the ultimate retreat where endless relaxation and adventure await at your doorstep.

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night

all: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
